headline: Actor Ilias Kanchan, currently in Bangladesh for treatment, to return to London this month for further care
summary: The renowned actor is currently undergoing treatment and will travel back to London to continue his medical care. He had briefly returned to Bangladesh during his treatment period.
details: Renowned Bangladeshi actor Ilias Kanchan is scheduled to return to London this month. He will continue his ongoing medical treatment there.
Kanchan had recently come back to Bangladesh for a brief period during his treatment. His return to London signifies the continuation of his specialized care.
